cases.title: Add single note normal behavior
cases.description: Verify that clicking the Add note button once creates a new note appended to the document body as a div element with the class 'note', containing a visible, empty textarea with data-testid='note-textarea'.

cases.title: Multiple rapid clicks boundary behavior
cases.description: Verify that multiple rapid clicks on the Add note button successfully create separate notes concurrently, each containing its own distinct textarea.

cases.title: Markdown Rendering and Persistence
cases.description: Verify that typing valid Markdown in the textarea (data-testid="note-textarea") dynamically renders HTML in the main display area (data-testid="note-main") in real-time, and all changes are immediately reflected in local storage.

cases.title: Invalid Markdown Handling
cases.description: Verify that complex or invalid Markdown syntax (such as unmatched **) does not cause crashes or errors, and displays raw input when the user exits the edit mode by clicking the "Edit" button (data-testid="edit-note-button").

cases.title: Default Edit Mode on Note Creation and Mode Toggle
cases.description: Verify that when a user creates a new note upon page load, it immediately enters edit mode where the textarea (data-testid='note-textarea') is visible and the main content area (data-testid='note-main') is hidden. Clicking the 'Edit' button (data-testid='edit-note-button') successfully toggles between edit and view modes.

cases.title: Automatic Saving of Textarea Changes to Local Storage
cases.description: Verify that all changes typed into the note textarea are automatically and continuously saved to local storage, preserving the current state and content across sessions.

cases.title: Delete note successfully removes it from DOM and localStorage
cases.description: Verify that when the user clicks the delete button (data-testid="delete-note-button") associated with a note, the targeted note is immediately removed from the DOM and its corresponding entry is removed from localStorage.

cases.title: Retrieve and Render Saved Notes From LocalStorage
cases.description: Verify that when the webpage loads with saved notes in localStorage, the app dynamically creates a note div with tools, edit button, delete button, main div, and textarea for each note, rendering content in the main div and hiding the textarea when content exists.

cases.title: Render Empty Notes From LocalStorage With Textarea Visible
cases.description: Verify that notes retrieved from localStorage with no content show the textarea and hide the main div to allow immediate editing.

cases.title: Load App With Empty LocalStorage
cases.description: Verify that when localStorage is empty, no notes are displayed on the page.

opinions.feedback: All requirements have well-defined, distinct, and testable cases covering both normal and error/edge scenarios. No blockers found.
All test cases cover the requirements appropriately and include distinct scenarios for normal and error/edge conditions.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-1: Normal: Single click on 'Add note' creates a div with class 'note', visible textarea with data-testid='note-textarea'. Boundary: Multiple rapid clicks on 'Add note' create multiple separate notes. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-2: Normal: Typing valid Markdown in textarea dynamically renders in note-main; changes persist to localStorage. Edge: Invalid Markdown (e.g., unmatched **) handled without crashing; displays raw input when exiting edit mode via 'Edit' button. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-3: Normal: Page load allows creating a note which enters edit mode by default (textarea visible, note-main hidden); clicking 'Edit' button toggles between view and edit modes. Edge: Changes typed into textarea automatically saved to local storage. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-4: Normal: Clicking 'Delete' button removes the targeted note from the DOM and localStorage. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-5: Normal: Page load retrieves saved notes from localStorage, renders them with tools, edit/delete buttons, main div, and textarea; notes with content show main div and hide textarea, empty notes show textarea and hide main div. Boundary: Empty localStorage displays no notes.
